question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**depending**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here, "continue" is a verb that is followed by a gerund (the "-ing" form of the verb). In this case, "continue depending" is the correct phrase.
 
• The structure "continue + verb-ing" is used to show an ongoing action or state. For example, "continue working," "continue eating," or "continue depending."
 
• "**Depending**" fits well as it aligns with the grammatical structure calling for the base form of the verb.
